image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a large common iguana perched on a thick branch. The iguana is facing left, with its head resting near the end of the branch. The lighting is somewhat dim and diffuse, possibly from an enclosure, causing some glare on the right side. The iguana's skin texture is visible, showing granular scales and larger plates on the head. A prominent dorsal crest runs down its neck and back. The front limbs are gripping the branch, though the digits are partially obscured by the angle and resolution. The background is a blurry mix of earthy tones, likely rock or soil.
